coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: One of five ground-truth variable items is substantially matched (20%): the torsion-angle autocorrelation formula. The design also mentions reference, subsampled, and generated trajectories, but does not match their required temporal resolutions.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces the specified pooled 30k-frame test data with new simulations recorded every 2–5 fs. It omits fixed training crops of up to 256 residues, every-40-frame training subsampling, and full-protein inference. It does not specify the required 10 ps-to-100 fs upsampling comparison or the 100 fs–100 ps autocorrelation lag range. Dynamic content as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale is absent; unrelated spectral, velocity, and kinetic metrics are added instead.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that MDGEN recovers sub-picosecond oscillations, closely matches ground-truth autocorrelation curves, and produces non-monotonic dynamic content, whereas subsampled trajectories lack these features.
